title: Lead I - Software Testing(Cypress)
description:
**Role description**  


We are looking for an experienced Cypress Automation Test Engineer with 6\+ years of overall testing experience and strong hands\-on expertise in designing, developing, and maintaining automation solutions using Cypress.



The ideal candidate should have strong proficiency in JavaScript or TypeScript, experience in frontend and backend testing, REST API validation, database testing, and CI/CD integration. The candidate should also possess strong debugging, analytical, and problem\-solving capabilities and be comfortable working within an Agile/Scrum delivery environment.


**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, execute, and maintain automated test scripts using Cypress.
* Develop scalable and reusable automation frameworks and test components.
* Perform frontend and backend functional testing, including manual testing when required.
* Perform REST API testing using Cypress and/or Postman.
* Validate backend data and application functionality using SQL queries.
* Analyze test execution results, identify defects, and perform root\-cause analysis.
* Debug automation failures and work closely with development teams to resolve application and test\-related issues.
* Integrate automated test suites with CI/CD pipelines.
* Manage automation code and test assets using Git/Bitbucket.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, grooming, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Collaborate with developers, product owners, business analysts, and other QA team members to ensure comprehensive test coverage.
* Identify opportunities to improve test automation coverage, execution efficiency, and overall product quality.

**Mandatory Skills \& Experience**
* Minimum 6\+ years of experience in software testing / quality engineering.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Cypress automation testing.
* Strong programming/scripting skills in JavaScript or TypeScript.
* Good experience in frontend and backend manual testing.
* Experience with REST API testing using Cypress and/or Postman.
* Good knowledge of SQL and experience performing database validations.
* Hands\-on experience with Git and/or Bitbucket for version control.
* Experience integrating and executing automated tests through at least one CI/CD platform such as:
	+ Jenkins
	+ Azure DevOps
	+ GitHub Actions
	+ GitLab CI/CD
* Good understanding of Agile/Scrum methodology.
* Strong debugging and troubleshooting capabilities.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Good communication and collaboration skills.

Good to Have / Preferred Skills
* Experience with Playwright automation testing.
* Experience working on projects within the Retail domain.
* Experience developing or enhancing automation frameworks.
* Exposure to end\-to\-end testing involving UI, API, and database layers.


  

**Skills**  

Cypress, Bitbucket, Git, Postman

 **About UST**  

UST is a global digital transformation solutions provider. For more than 20 years, UST has worked side by side with the world’s best companies to make a real impact through transformation. Powered by technology, inspired by people and led by purpose, UST partners with their clients from design to operation. With deep domain expertise and a future\-proof philosophy, UST embeds innovation and agility into their clients’ organizations. With over 30,000 employees in 30 countries, UST builds for boundless impact—touching billions of lives in the process.

title: Completions Optimization Engineer
description:
The Completions Optimization Engineer (COE) works within a 24x7 operation team and serves as a trusted advisor directly engaged with both customers and multi\-discipline NOV resources delivering end\-to\-end data solutions that connect customers’ wellsite operations to their office. The COE is the primary point of contact for key customers to support their deployments and address challenging problems related to data delivery. As a data analyst for NOV Max Completions this individual will ensure a uniform and holistic digital window to onsite completions operations. Data curation is critical to enable this functionality.


  
• Primary responsibility is managing customer’s real time data during frac operations for continuity, context, and data quality.


• Monitor customer success with NOV solutions and perform daily data integrity checks.


• Represent “the voice of the customer” to NOV sales, development, and support teams.


• Support completions software solution development with operational experience in fracturing and related data systems.


• Create and maintain plans to manage successful solution deployments.


• Setup backend system for new equipment and resources being onboarded to NOV Max Completions system.


• Communicate installation needs to field engineering team.


• Delivery of the technical solutions, including hands\-on configuration and deployment of solution components.


• Develop workflows for managing completions data in both NOV systems and sync with customer’s data systems.


• Communicate post job data needs to service company personnel.


• Proven ability to define client issues and leverage resources to solve problems.


• Other duties as assigned.


  
• Bachelor of Science Degree, or equivalent experience.


• 2\-5 years of experience in Product, Operational, or Engineering roles.


• Completions experience is required.


• Field engineering experience in Hydraulic Fracturing and/or Jointed Pipe is a strong plus.


• General understanding of IT infrastructure concepts (servers, databases, security, etc.) a plus.


• Basic networking troubleshooting skills a plus.


• Basic electronics troubleshooting skills a plus.

title: Product Engineer
description:
About Nutcracklab

Nutcracklab is an AI analytics company building intelligent products that help businesses make better decisions using data, predictive analytics and artificial intelligence.We are building a portfolio of AI\-driven products across multiple business domains and are looking for a **Founding Product Engineer** to help take these products from MVP and prototype stages into reliable, production\-ready systems.

Required SkillsMust Have

· **4\+ years of professional software engineering experience**

· Strong **Python** development skills

· Strong **SQL** skills

· Experience with **PostgreSQL** or equivalent relational databases

· Experience building **REST APIs**

· Experience with **FastAPI, Flask, Django or equivalent**

· Strong experience with **Pandas / NumPy**

· Experience with machine learning, predictive analytics or AI applications

· Experience with **Git/GitHub**

· Experience with **Docker**

· Experience deploying applications to a cloud environment

· Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills

· Understanding of software architecture and production engineering practices

Preferred

· Experience with **Microsoft Azure**

· Azure ML or equivalent ML deployment experience

· Experience with **Streamlit**

· Data engineering / ETL

· API and third\-party system integrations

· CI/CD and GitHub Actions

· Application monitoring and logging

· Multi\-tenant SaaS architecture

· Experience taking products from **prototype/MVP → production**

· Experience working in **retail, e\-commerce or other data\-intensive business domains**

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who:

· Takes ownership rather than waiting for detailed instructions.

· Can independently investigate and solve technical problems.

· Is comfortable working with incomplete or evolving requirements.

· Can make practical architecture and technology decisions.

· Can balance speed of delivery with engineering quality.

· Enjoys working across multiple technical areas rather than being restricted to one narrow function.

· Has strong product thinking in addition to coding ability.

· Is comfortable working directly with founders and customers.

· Is excited by the opportunity to build new products from the ground up.

Why Join Nutcracklab?

This is an early\-stage opportunity with significant technical ownership.

You will have the opportunity to:

· Build AI products from the ground up.

· Work directly with the founder.

· Influence architecture and technology decisions.

· Work across AI, data and product engineering.

· Take products from **idea → prototype → MVP → production**.

· Help establish the company’s engineering culture and technical foundation.

· Eventually help build and lead the engineering team as the product portfolio grows.

Pay: ₹300,000\.00 \- ₹600,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person
